title: Line sketch: Highway Under Fiery Sunset
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A multi-lane highway with glowing car lights leads the eye toward a distant city skyline silhouetted against a blazing sunset. Layered buildings, towers, and hazy clouds create depth beneath dramatic and skies. Broad, loose and atmospheric blending emphasize light and mood over detail (derived from painting #92).
